subject: Science
stem: When ice at 0°C melts into water at 0°C, heat is being continuously supplied, yet the temperature does not rise during the process. This heat, absorbed without a temperature change, used only to break the bonds between molecules during a change of state, is called:
explanation: Latent heat is the 'hidden' heat absorbed or released during a phase change (melting, boiling) without any temperature change, as the energy goes into breaking/forming intermolecular bonds — unlike specific heat, which raises the temperature of a substance without changing its state.

subject: Environmental Studies
stem: An Amoeba reproduces by simply dividing its single cell into two identical daughter cells, each growing into a complete new organism — without involving gametes or fertilisation. This method of asexual reproduction is called:
explanation: Binary fission splits one parent cell into two roughly equal daughter cells (seen in Amoeba, bacteria) — distinct from budding (a small outgrowth develops into a new organism, as in Hydra/yeast) or fragmentation (the body breaks into pieces, each regenerating, as in Spirogyra).
